meta.profile: Senior Marketing / Growth / GTM / Partnerships leader, SF Bay Area, $160k+ base, B2B SaaS / AI / fintech focus

tier1_highest_volume.name: LinkedIn Jobs
tier1_highest_volume.notes: Largest single source. Use salary filter f_SB2=6 (>$160k). Sort by date (sortBy=DD). Scrape job IDs, resolve to ATS URLs.

tier1_highest_volume.name: Greenhouse Job Board (direct)
tier1_highest_volume.notes: VERIFIED DEAD 2026-07-19: boards.greenhouse.io/search returns 404. Greenhouse has no cross-company search page. Use tier6_direct_company_careers (per-company boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{slug}/jobs) instead — real public JSON API, no login.

tier1_highest_volume.name: Ashby Job Board (direct)
tier1_highest_volume.notes: VERIFIED DEAD 2026-07-19: jobs.ashbyhq.com/search returns 'Page not found'. Ashby has no cross-company search. Use tier6_direct_company_careers (per-company api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug}) instead — unofficial but working public JSON API, no login.

tier1_highest_volume.name: Lever Job Board (direct)
tier1_highest_volume.notes: VERIFIED DEAD 2026-07-19: jobs.lever.co/search returns 404. Lever has no cross-company search. Use tier6_direct_company_careers (per-company api.lever.co/v0/postings/{slug}?mode=json) instead — real public JSON API, no login.

tier2_high_signal.name: Built In SF
tier2_high_signal.notes: Curated SF+remote tech. Seniority filter critical — most roles are IC. Use built-in salary filter when available.

tier2_high_signal.name: Wellfound (AngelList)
tier2_high_signal.notes: Strong for Series A-C startups. Already have wellfound-apply skill. Salary filter available.

tier2_high_signal.name: Y Combinator Jobs
tier2_high_signal.notes: YC portfolio companies. High quality signal. Many use Ashby. Filter for 'Senior' and above.

tier2_high_signal.name: Work at a Startup (HN)
tier2_high_signal.notes: HN/YC community board. Already have workatastartup skill. Use exp=4 (director+).

tier2_high_signal.name: ExecThread
tier2_high_signal.notes: Executive-only referral network. Invite-required for posting but free to search. High match quality for VP+.

tier2_high_signal.name: Lenny's Newsletter Jobs
tier2_high_signal.notes: Product/growth/marketing focused. Smaller volume but very high quality. Most roles are product growth or marketing leadership.

tier3_specialist.name: Crunchbase Jobs
tier3_specialist.notes: Funded startup focus. Good for Series B+ companies. Cross-reference funding stage with company page.

tier3_specialist.name: Glassdoor Jobs
tier3_specialist.notes: Large volume but high noise. Salary filter and seniority filter essential.

tier3_specialist.name: Indeed
tier3_specialist.notes: High volume, mixed quality. Filter: salary >$160k, senior level. Many repost from ATS — dedup by company+title.

tier3_specialist.name: Remote OK
tier3_specialist.notes: Strong for fully remote roles. Has public JSON API. Filter by salary and seniority in API response.

tier3_specialist.name: The Muse
tier3_specialist.notes: Company culture + job listings. Good for filtering by company values. Seniority filter available.

tier3_specialist.name: Dice
tier3_specialist.notes: Primarily tech roles. Useful for growth/marketing-tech hybrid roles at established tech companies.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: HN Who's Hiring (monthly thread)
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: HN monthly 'Who's Hiring' thread via Algolia API. Scrape comments, grep for marketing/growth/VP/director. Small but very high signal — often early-stage or stealth companies.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Pallet Jobs
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Creator/newsletter-curated job boards. Several marketing-focused pallets with senior roles.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Marketing Hire
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Marketing-only job board. Smaller but highly filtered — every role is marketing.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Jobgether
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Remote-first jobs. Good salary filter. Aggregates from multiple sources.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Himalayas
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Remote-first, good filtering. Emerging board with clean job data.

tier4_niche_high_quality.name: Arc.dev
tier4_niche_high_quality.notes: Mostly engineering but has marketing/growth roles. Worth occasional check.

tier5_aggregators.name: Otta
tier5_aggregators.notes: Good seniority filters (5=director, 6=VP+). Strong for EU-originated companies with US offices.

tier5_aggregators.name: Simplyhired
tier5_aggregators.notes: Aggregator. Lower noise than Indeed but same dedup required.

tier5_aggregators.name: ZipRecruiter
tier5_aggregators.notes: Large volume. Salary filter + 7-day recency essential to reduce noise.

tier6_direct_company_careers.notes: Verified 2026-07-19 via live API calls (no login required). Greenhouse/Lever have real public JSON APIs; Ashby uses an unofficial but working public endpoint. Cross-company search pages for all three ATSes are DEAD (see tier1 notes) — this per-company list is the only reliable no-login path. job_count_verified is total open roles at verification time (not filtered to marketing/senior) — apply seniority_gate + search_keywords filter when querying each api_url. Expanded round 2 (2026-07-19): +28 companies (Braze, Fivetran, Klaviyo, Harvey, Sierra, 1Password, Supabase, Outreach, Attentive, Tailscale, Salesloft, and more). Round 3 (2026-07-19): +32 companies (Zscaler, Adyen, Block, Chime, SoFi, LaunchDarkly, Betterment, PagerDuty, Persona, PostHog, Sardine, and more fintech/security/devtools). Expanded round 3 (2026-07-29): +48 companies verified live via Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/SmartRecruiters public APIs, 164 total tracked. Round 4 (2026-08-03) — ATS TYPE gap research: verified 2 new working per-company API patterns (workable, recruitee) beyond the existing greenhouse/ashby/lever/smartrecruiters, plus documented (not yet company-populated) workday and personio patterns. See ats_type_reference below before adding a company on one of these types — the endpoint shape differs per ATS and a wrong guess silently 404s rather than warning. Round 5 (2026-08-03): +187 companies verified live via Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/SmartRecruiters public APIs (all independently re-verified for non-empty job data before merging), 351 total tracked. Sourced from B2B SaaS/AI-infra/fintech/devtools sectors specifically to grow the pool of companies likely to have Director+/VP/Head-of marketing-leadership openings, after a 30-day scan against the prior 164-company list surfaced only 5 relevant candidates. Workable slugs could not be verified this round — Cloudflare challenged/429'd every request; revisit via a real browser session (ego-browser/Claude-in-Chrome) if Workable coverage is wanted later. A few companies (dataiku, found, hackerrank, hootsuite, newrelic, seekout, sisense, beamery, gainsight, paradox, socure, appen, mindtickle) appear twice under two different ATS types — confirmed via each board's own company-name metadata to be the same real company running boards on both platforms, not duplicates; kept both since the scan dedupes by job_id, not by company. Round 6 (2026-08-03): +353 companies verified live via Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/SmartRecruiters public APIs, 704 total tracked. Cast a wider sector net (e-commerce/retail-tech, HR-tech, vertical SaaS, martech, cybersecurity, RevTech, general Series C+/public B2B SaaS) to grow beyond the AI-infra/fintech focus of round 5. Independently re-verified every entry (non-empty job data; SmartRecruiters entries additionally required a posting released within the last 365 days after discovering dead boards — e.g. buildium/dribbble/fiverr/servicetitan/criteriacorp/mytime — still return totalFound>0 years after their last real posting). Dropped 3 wrong-identity slug collisions found via company-name spot-check: 'sterling' resolves to Sterling Brands (a branding agency, not the intended company — same false match already caught and excluded in round 5, recurred in this independent pass), 'insider' resolves to Business Insider (media company), 'remote' resolves to General Assembly Remote Jobs (not the fintech 'Remote'). Lesson: single-word/generic company-name slugs need identity verification via the API's own company-name field every time, even if a similar-sounding company was verified correctly before — the collision risk doesn't go away. Round 7 (2026-08-03): +61 companies sourced from top VC firms' portfolio job boards (Thrive Capital, Redpoint, Craft Ventures, Khosla, Menlo, Scale VP, Sapphire, Emergence Capital, Founders Fund) rather than general-knowledge slug-guessing — company names extracted from live portfolio job board content, then each independently verified against Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever/SmartRecruiters APIs (same recency check applied to SmartRecruiters hits as prior rounds). 765 total tracked. Round 8 (2026-08-03): +154 companies, 919 total tracked. Sourced from cybersecurity (Bugcrowd, BigID, OneTrust, Axonius, Abnormal Security, Huntress, SecurityScorecard), UK/EU/Israel fintech (TrueLayer, GoCardless, Monzo, N26, Payoneer, Thunes, Pagaya), AI infra/dev tools (WorkOS, Metabase, Apollo GraphQL, Firecrawl, Exa, Tavily), defense/space/deep-tech (Shield AI, Saronic, Helsing, Chaos Industries, Oklo, Kairos Power), and 2025-2026 frontier AI labs (Thinking Machines, Reflection AI, Lila Sciences, World Labs, Poolside, Hebbia). All independently re-verified for non-empty job data; SmartRecruiters attempts in this round mostly failed the 365-day staleness check (CPG/retail names tried, only Delivery Hero passed).

ats_type_reference.note: Every cross-company aggregator/marketing-specific community job board was checked in the 2026-08-03 gap research (Ladders, RevGenius, Superpath, GrowthHackers, Demand Curve, Product Marketing Alliance, CMO Alliance, Fishbowl, MarketerHire) and found dead, paywalled, bot-blocked, wrong-seniority, or too thin on inventory to be registry-worthy — the real gap in this registry is Workday-based large enterprises under-represented in the company list below, not aggregators. Do not re-research these without new evidence they've changed.
ats_type_reference.ashby: GET https://api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/{slug} — date field: job.publishedAt; check job.isListed !== false
ats_type_reference.smartrecruiters: GET https://api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/{slug}/postings — verified live 2026-08-03 against Visa; enterprise-skewed company base
ats_type_reference.workable: GET https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{slug} — verified live 2026-08-03 against huggingface/canva/loom; date field: job.published_on; mid-size tech/startup company base, no server-side filtering (fetch full board, filter client-side like greenhouse)
ats_type_reference.recruitee: GET https://{slug}.recruitee.com/api/offers — verified live 2026-08-03 against safetyculture (wrong slug correctly 404s, confirmed per-tenant not shared namespace); mostly EU mid-size scaleups, moderate relevance to SF Bay Area target profile, add only per confirmed company
ats_type_reference.workday: POST https://{tenant}.wd{N}.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs with JSON body {appliedFacets:{}, limit:20, offset:0, searchText:''} — verified live 2026-08-03 against HP's tenant (not added as a tracked company, was a pattern-verification test only). Highest-value untapped gap: Workday is the dominant ATS at large enterprises/Fortune 500, which this registry under-represents relative to startups. NOT a GET-able URL like the other 5 types — needs a POST-capable fetch. tenant/site/data-center (wd1/wd3/wd5...) is NOT guessable from company name and must be discovered from that company's live careers URL before it can be added here — do not fabricate a tenant guess.
ats_type_reference.personio: GET https://{slug}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language=en (some tenants use .com) — verified live 2026-08-03 (well-formed XML, empty results in spot check). Primarily German/EU HR platform, low relevance to SF Bay Area/remote-US search — only add for a specific confirmed company, not worth proactive sourcing.

weekly_rotation: Run tier1 sources (LinkedIn, direct Greenhouse/Ashby/Lever) every session
Run tier2 sources (Built In SF, Wellfound, YC, ExecThread, Lenny's) every 3 days
Run HN Who's Hiring API on first Monday of each month
Scan tier6 direct company career pages weekly (automate via HTTP batch)
search_strategy.dedup_strategy: Primary key: (company_name + job_title). Secondary: ATS job_id. Normalize company names (strip Inc/LLC/Corp). Cache seen job IDs in ~/.claude/skills/greenhouse-apply/data/seen-job-ids.json
search_strategy.salary_gate: Skip any listing where max_salary < 160000 OR no salary shown AND company stage is seed/pre-seed. Request salary info if Greenhouse form has salary field.
search_strategy.seniority_gate: Only apply to: Director, Senior Director, VP, SVP, EVP, Head of, CMO, CGO. Skip: Manager, Senior Manager, Lead, Principal (unless title contains 'Group' or equivalent).
